title: Dynamic Scaling of Unit Tests for Code Reward Modeling
authors_zh: Zeyao Ma, Xiaokang Zhang, Jing Zhang, Jifan Yu, Sijia Luo, Jie Tang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: Dynamic Scaling of Unit Tests for Code Reward Modeling records candidate solutions generated unit tests execution rewards and test budgets under test-derived reward.
CodeRM 发布合成单元测试与错误率字段，并按题目难度动态分配测试时验证预算。
why: It makes difficulty-adaptive number of tests and BoN selection and its audit boundary visible for reasoning-data curation.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate with a concrete feedback/selection object: candidate solutions generated unit tests execution rewards and test budgets.

title: Problem
问题
html: Published as an ACL 2025 long paper, Dynamic Scaling of Unit Tests for Code Reward Modeling studies a test-time code-selection problem: repeated sampling can produce a correct program among many candidates, but selecting it requires a reliable verifier. LLM-generated unit tests provide executable feedback, yet erroneous or low-coverage tests can accept wrong programs or reject correct ones. The paper therefore asks whether scaling the verifier-side computation—the number of generated unit tests—improves the reward signal, and whether that budget should vary with problem difficulty. The relevant data objects are programming problems, candidate code solutions, generated unit tests containing input–expected-output cases, per-solution execution outcomes, selected solutions, difficulty labels or estimates, and per-problem test budgets. This Card treats these as a construction and evaluation recipe for rollout/search/test-time-compute data; it does not infer that complete rollout logs or a reusable corpus are available.

该文以 ACL 2025 长文发表，研究测试时代码选择问题：重复采样可能在多个候选中产生正确程序，但最终输出仍依赖可靠的验证器。LLM 生成的单元测试能够提供可执行反馈，却可能因预期输出错误或覆盖不足而误收错误程序、误拒正确程序。因此，论文考察扩大验证器侧计算量——即增加生成单元测试的数量——能否改善奖励信号，以及是否应按题目难度分配测试预算。与本卡相关的数据对象包括编程题、候选代码解答、由输入—期望输出用例组成的生成单元测试、每个解答的执行结果、被选中的解答、难度标签或估计值，以及逐题测试预算。本卡将其视为 rollout、搜索与测试时计算数据的构造和评估配方；不据此推断完整 rollout 日志或可复用语料已经公开。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper scales the verifier rather than only the policy. For a programming problem, a policy model samples multiple candidate solutions; a unit-test generator produces multiple tests conditioned on the problem and a candidate solution; execution yields a binary result for each solution–test pair; and majority voting selects the candidate passing the most tests. The authors train CodeRM-8B, based on Llama3.1-8B, to generate tests from problem–solution inputs using synthetically constructed supervision. They also train a lightweight probe that estimates problem difficulty from model hidden states and use a greedy allocator to assign more unit-test budget to harder problems. The feedback contract is programmatic but imperfect: execution is deterministic under the stated Python setting, while the generated test inputs and expected outputs remain model-produced and can be wrong. Relative to fixed-count unit-test reranking such as CodeT, MBR-Exec, and MPSC, the distinctive object is difficulty-conditioned scaling of verifier samples under a fixed overall budget.

论文扩展的是验证器侧计算，而不只是策略模型侧采样。对一道编程题，策略模型先生成多个候选解答；单元测试生成器根据题目与候选解答产生多组测试；执行过程为每个“解答—测试”组合给出二元结果；多数投票最终选择通过测试数量最多的候选。作者以 Llama3.1-8B 为底座，通过合成监督训练 CodeRM-8B，使其从“题目—解答”输入生成测试；同时利用模型隐藏状态训练轻量难度探针，再用贪心分配器为较难题目配置更多单元测试预算。该反馈契约属于程序化验证但并非完美验证：在论文所述 Python 环境中，执行结果是确定的，但测试输入和期望输出由模型生成，仍可能出错。相较 CodeT、MBR-Exec、MPSC 等固定测试数量的重排序方法，其关键新增对象是在固定总预算下按难度扩展验证器采样。

title: Method
方法
html:
The synthesis pipeline starts from CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction and the training split of TACO. Llama3.1-70B filters questions unsuitable for conventional unit testing, including tasks involving randomness, and the retained reference solutions are converted to functional form. Conditioned on each problem and reference solution, Llama3.1-70B repeatedly samples unit tests. Tests are executed against the reference solution: passing tests are retained, while failing tests can be repaired using Python-interpreter feedback. A quality-control stage generates incorrect solutions with a less capable model and removes false-positive tests that fail to reject those incorrect solutions. CodeRM-8B is then supervised-fine-tuned from Llama3.1-8B with the problem plus code solution as the instruction and a filtered unit test as the target.

At selection time, candidate solution Ci receives one binary result per generated unit test: 1 only when it passes all cases in that test, otherwise 0. The selected solution maximizes the sum of these results. For dynamic scaling, repeated policy samples are checked with previously collected correct tests; their mean pass rate supplies the difficulty target. A two-layer feed-forward probe maps decoding hidden states to a scalar predicted pass rate, and a greedy algorithm allocates test-generation budget using the paper's utility q(x,b)=1-(1-λ)^b. Main experiments use HumanEval Plus, MBPP Plus, and 168 functional-format LiveCodeBench problems from 2024-01 through 2024-09. The paper reports temperature 0.8 and top-p 0.95 for solution and test generation. An official ACL paper and project URL are printed in the PDF, but this Card has no verified official code or data-release link; exact released schemas, record counts, splits, checksums, and complete replay logs therefore remain unknown.

合成流水线以 CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction 和 TACO 训练集为来源。Llama3.1-70B 先筛除不适合常规单元测试的问题，包括涉及随机性的任务，并将保留的参考解答转换为函数形式。随后，Llama3.1-70B 根据每个“题目—参考解答”组合重复采样单元测试。测试在参考解答上执行：通过者被保留，失败者可利用 Python 解释器反馈进行修复。质量控制阶段再由能力较弱的模型生成错误解答，并删除无法拒绝这些错误解答的假阳性测试。最后，以“题目加代码解答”为指令、过滤后的单元测试为目标，从 Llama3.1-8B 监督微调得到 CodeRM-8B。

在选择阶段，候选解答 Ci 对每个生成单元测试获得一个二元结果：只有通过该测试内全部用例时记为 1，否则为 0；最终选择这些结果之和最大的解答。动态扩展阶段先用已收集的正确测试检查策略模型的重复采样解答，以平均通过率作为难度目标；一个两层前馈探针将解码隐藏状态映射为标量预测通过率，再通过论文给出的效用函数 q(x,b)=1-(1-λ)^b 和贪心算法分配测试生成预算。主要实验使用 HumanEval Plus、MBPP Plus，以及 LiveCodeBench 中 2024-01 至 2024-09 的 168 道函数形式题目。论文报告解答与测试生成的 temperature 为 0.8、top-p 为 0.95。PDF 中给出了 ACL 论文页和项目网址，但本卡尚未核验到官方代码或数据发布链接；因此，实际发布的数据模式、记录数、划分、校验和及完整重放日志均保持 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper's pioneer experiment uses HumanEval Plus with up to 200 candidate solutions and 100 generated unit tests per problem, plus bootstrap resampling, and reports that adding tests generally improves best-of-N selection across several policy and test-generator models. The effect is larger on harder problem quintiles, motivating dynamic allocation. In the main three-benchmark comparison, CodeRM-8B raises HumanEval Plus Pass@1 over random selection by 18.43 points for Llama3-8B and 3.42 points for GPT-4o-mini; results also improve on MBPP Plus and LiveCodeBench for the evaluated policy models. Under fixed compute, dynamic allocation provides only a modest additional gain, reported as up to about 0.5 points on MBPP Plus.

The paper also evaluates test-verifier behavior with accuracy, F1, false-acceptance rate, and false-rejection rate, and ablates false-positive filtering and training-set size. These results support the claim that test count, filtering, and allocation affect this verifier's downstream selection behavior. They are not record-level proof that every synthetic unit test is correct, diverse, uncontaminated, or useful outside the reported Python function-generation setting. Benchmark gains likewise do not establish the quality or completeness of an eventual public dataset.

论文的先导实验在 HumanEval Plus 上为每题使用最多 200 个候选解答和 100 个生成单元测试，并通过 bootstrap 重采样统计结果；实验显示，在多种策略模型和测试生成模型组合中，增加测试数量通常能改善 best-of-N 选择。较难题目分位上的收益更大，由此引出动态预算分配。在三项基准的主要对比中，相比随机选择，CodeRM-8B 使 Llama3-8B 和 GPT-4o-mini 在 HumanEval Plus 上的 Pass@1 分别提高 18.43 和 3.42 个百分点；在所评估策略模型上，MBPP Plus 与 LiveCodeBench 也出现提升。在固定计算量下，动态分配带来的额外收益较小，论文报告其在 MBPP Plus 上最高约为 0.5 个百分点。

论文还以准确率、F1、假接受率和假拒绝率评估测试验证器行为，并消融假阳性过滤与训练数据规模。这些结果支持“测试数量、过滤和预算分配会影响该验证器的下游选择行为”，但不能逐条证明每个合成单元测试都正确、多样、无污染，也不能证明其可迁移到论文所评估的 Python 函数生成场景之外。同样，基准提升不构成未来公开数据集质量或完整性的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Generated-test reranking predates this work: CodeT, MBR-Exec, and related methods already execute generated tests to rank sampled programs, while test-time scaling work often increases the number of policy outputs. This paper combines three changes: an execution-filtered synthetic dataset for a dedicated 8B test generator, empirical scaling of the number of verifier samples, and difficulty-aware allocation of verifier compute. Its direction signal for the rollout/search/test-time-compute track is the separation of policy-sampling budget from verifier-sampling budget and the explicit attempt to allocate the latter by estimated difficulty.

The execution contract itself, supervised fine-tuning, majority voting, probing, and greedy allocation are not individually new. The paper does not establish a general scaling law, and its dynamic allocator adapts a policy-compute objective that the authors acknowledge may be mismatched to verifier compute. The contribution should therefore be read as a code-specific construction and scaling study, not as evidence that more tests universally produce higher-quality rewards.

使用生成测试重排序并非该文首创：CodeT、MBR-Exec 等方法已经通过执行生成测试来排序采样程序，测试时扩展研究也常增加策略模型输出数量。该文组合了三项变化：为专用 8B 测试生成器构造经过执行过滤的合成数据、实证扩展验证器采样数量，以及按难度分配验证器计算。对 rollout、搜索与测试时计算方向而言，其信号在于区分策略采样预算和验证器采样预算，并显式尝试依据估计难度分配后者。

执行契约、监督微调、多数投票、探针和贪心分配本身均非单项新技术。论文没有建立普适扩展定律，而且动态分配器沿用了策略计算目标；作者也承认该目标可能与验证器计算并不匹配。因此，应将贡献理解为面向代码任务的构造与扩展研究，而不能据此认为增加测试数量必然产生更高质量奖励。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The verifier inherits an oracle problem: a generated test can contain an incorrect expected output, miss important behavior, or encode a narrow shortcut. Passing more correlated tests is therefore not equivalent to semantic program correctness. Filtering against one reference solution and model-generated incorrect solutions reduces some false positives but cannot enumerate all valid implementations or failure modes.

The authors report reward hacking in which adding tests lowers best-of-N performance: 9.76% of HumanEval Plus problems and 7.41% of MBPP Plus problems show degradation under their criterion, with the hardest HumanEval Plus quintile especially affected. This directly challenges the assumption that harder problems should always receive more verifier compute. The dynamic method yields modest gains, imports an allocation objective developed for policy sampling, and may plateau as test count grows. Diversity and coverage under scaling are not characterized by a formal law. Evaluation is limited to short, function-level Python tasks; LiveCodeBench reduces but does not eliminate generalization concerns and does not represent repository-scale software engineering. Finally, the paper states that CodeRM-8B parameters and training data would be released, but without a verified official release link their present availability, exact contents, license attachment, lineage metadata, and reproducibility remain unknown.

该验证器继承了测试预言问题：生成测试的期望输出可能错误，可能遗漏关键行为，也可能编码狭窄捷径。因此，通过更多相互相关的测试并不等同于程序语义正确。使用一个参考解答和模型生成的错误解答进行过滤可以减少部分假阳性，却无法枚举所有有效实现或失败模式。

作者报告了“增加测试反而降低 best-of-N 性能”的奖励黑客现象：按其判定标准，HumanEval Plus 和 MBPP Plus 中分别有 9.76% 与 7.41% 的题目出现退化，HumanEval Plus 最难分位尤其明显。这直接削弱了“较难题目总应获得更多验证器计算”的假设。动态方法的收益较小，并沿用了为策略采样提出的分配目标；随着测试数量增加，收益也可能饱和。论文未用形式化定律刻画扩展后的多样性与覆盖率。评估仅覆盖短小、函数级 Python 任务；LiveCodeBench 虽降低了部分污染风险，但不能消除泛化问题，也不代表仓库级软件工程。最后，论文声明将发布 CodeRM-8B 参数和训练数据，但在尚无已核验官方发布链接的情况下，其当前可用性、确切内容、许可证附着方式、血缘元数据和可复现性均为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout/search/test-time-compute track, this work supplies a concrete schema for verifier-side traces: problem, sampled candidate solutions, generated tests, execution matrix, aggregate vote, selected candidate, predicted difficulty, and allocated test budget. Such records can support budget-aware reranking studies, verifier calibration, false-acceptance and false-rejection audits, and comparisons between fixed and adaptive verifier compute. The synthesis recipe is also relevant when constructing unit-test-generator SFT data, provided users preserve source-dataset lineage, reference solutions, repair histories, rejected tests, and execution environments.

Reuse should keep two objects separate: the training examples used to fit CodeRM-8B and the test-time execution traces used to rank candidate programs. The reported benchmark improvements justify studying this feedback contract, not treating generated tests as ground truth or expanding the paper into unsupported RLVR, process-supervision, or general software-engineering claims.

对 rollout、搜索与测试时计算方向，该工作给出了验证器侧轨迹的具体模式：题目、采样候选解答、生成测试、执行矩阵、聚合投票、被选候选、预测难度和分配的测试预算。这类记录可用于预算感知重排序、验证器校准、假接受与假拒绝审计，以及固定和自适应验证器计算的比较。若保留源数据集血缘、参考解答、修复历史、被拒测试和执行环境，该合成配方也可用于构造单元测试生成器的 SFT 数据。

复用时应明确区分两类对象：用于训练 CodeRM-8B 的样本，以及测试时用于排序候选程序的执行轨迹。论文报告的基准提升说明该反馈契约值得研究，但不能据此把生成测试视为 ground truth，也不能将论文外推为缺乏证据的 RLVR、过程监督或通用软件工程结论。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Reproduce the execution matrix and report false-acceptance and false-rejection rates against hidden reference tests, rather than auditing only the final Pass@1 gain.
  • Preserve generated, repaired, accepted, and rejected tests with generator version, prompt, sampling seed, interpreter version, timeout, and exception logs.
  • Check source-dataset licenses, duplicates, and overlap with HumanEval Plus, MBPP Plus, and the selected LiveCodeBench date range before reusing the synthetic records.
  • Compare fixed and dynamic budgets at equal policy samples, test-generation calls, executions, and wall-clock cost; stratify failures by predicted and gold difficulty.
  • Verify whether an official CodeRM-8B model/data release exists and whether it contains record schemas, splits, checksums, lineage, and the difficulty-classifier artifacts promised by the paper.

• 重现完整执行矩阵，并以隐藏参考测试报告假接受率和假拒绝率，不要只审计最终 Pass@1 提升。
  • 保存生成、修复、接受和拒绝的测试，同时记录生成器版本、提示词、采样种子、解释器版本、超时及异常日志。
  • 复用合成记录前，核对源数据集许可证、重复项，以及其与 HumanEval Plus、MBPP Plus 和所选 LiveCodeBench 时间段的重叠。
  • 在策略采样数、测试生成调用数、实际执行数和墙钟成本相同的条件下比较固定与动态预算，并按预测难度和真实难度分层审计失败。
  • 核验是否已有官方 CodeRM-8B 模型或数据发布，以及其中是否包含论文承诺的记录模式、划分、校验和、血缘和难度分类器工件。
